title: Tsukiji breakfast · teamLab Planets · Toyosu onsen · Asakusa Hagoita-ichi at dusk · Tsukishima monja · Ikebukuro karaoke

stops.name: Ninja House
stops.plan: Out the door at 06:50 for the market. Wear trousers that roll above the knee for teamLab.
stops.transport: Walk to Ochiai-minami-nagasaki, Toei Oedo line direct to Tsukijishijo, about 64 min door to door

stops.name: Tsukiji Outer Market breakfast crawl
stops.plan: Graze in pairs: tamagoyaki on a stick, grilled scallops, tuna and uni stalls; Kitsuneya horumon-don in shifts at the counter.
stops.transport: Walk to Shintomicho, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho line → Toyosu, Yurikamome → Shin-Toyosu, about 38 min

stops.name: teamLab Planets TOKYO
stops.plan: 10:30 timed slot for all 8 (book online ahead): barefoot through the water rooms, floating orbs and koi pond.

stops.name: Manyo Club Toyosu
stops.plan: Lunch and a beer in the restaurant, then the baths and the rooftop foot bath over the bay to recover from the early start.
stops.price: ¥4,000 pp bath set; lunch and drinks extra
stops.transport: Yurikamome Shijo-mae → Toyosu, Tokyo Metro Yurakucho line → Ginza-itchome, Ginza line Ginza → Asakusa, about 67 min door to door

stops.name: Senso-ji + Hagoita-ichi year-end fair
stops.plan: Kaminarimon and Nakamise at sunset, the temple, then the lit Hagoita-ichi stalls after dark and their hand-clap whenever a battledore sells.
stops.transport: Walk to Kuramae, Toei Oedo line Kuramae → Tsukishima, about 51 min door to door

stops.name: Tsukishima Monja Moheji (main shop)
stops.plan: Booked 19:15 table for 8 (two griddles side by side): monjayaki you cook yourselves, with beer.
stops.transport: Tokyo Metro Yurakucho line Tsukishima → Ikebukuro (direct), walk to the West Exit, about 48 min door to door

stops.name: Wakadaisho
stops.plan: Cheap Showa-style second round: flat-price plates, the famous nikomi and highballs; split across two tables if needed.

stops.name: Big Echo Ikebukuro Nishiguchi Ekimae
stops.plan: One big room for 8 booked online; 3-hour session with drinks, past the last train.
stops.transport: Taxi to Ninja House, 2 cars, 10 min plus pickup (about ¥1,400 per car)
